scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && concurrently --kill-others --names contracts,api,demo,qa "npm run dev --workspace @veriqa/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @veriqa/api" "npm run dev --workspace @veriqa/demo-web" "npm run dev --workspace @veriqa/qa-dashboard"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && npm run build --workspace @veriqa/api && npm run build --workspace @veriqa/demo-web && npm run build --workspace @veriqa/qa-dashboard
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && npm run test:unit --workspace @veriqa/api
scripts.plan: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && npm run plan --workspace @veriqa/api --
scripts.execute: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && npm run execute --workspace @veriqa/api --
scripts.test:executor: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && node --import tsx --test tests/integration/executor.test.ts
scripts.test:dashboard: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && playwright test --config playwright.dashboard.config.ts
scripts.evidence:verify: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/interview-evidence.ts verify
scripts.evidence:restore: npm run build --workspace @veriqa/contracts && node --import tsx scripts/interview-evidence.ts restore
